subject: Temporary sandbox voucher proposal while PO clears
messages:
From: Natalie Ruiz <natalie@clearpath.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearpath.ai
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Trial environment access — PO pending

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week — the team is excited about Redwood's latency and the KV-cache improvements. We're getting final sign-off from procurement but it's taking longer than expected because of a new vendor onboarding checklist.

Is there any way to keep our sandbox project active for a few more business days? The engineers need an extra week to finish their integration tests before the PO lands. If not, can you suggest any short-term option so we don't lose momentum?

Thanks,
Natalie
VP of Product
ClearPath AI

Attachment: ClearPath_initial_requirements.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Ruiz <natalie@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial environment access — PO pending

Hi Natalie — appreciate the heads-up and glad the demo resonated.

We can absolutely help short-term. Two practical options:

- Provision a short-term sandbox voucher (one-time token credit) that keeps your environment active for up to 10 business days while the PO is processed. We typically issue this for customers in procurement with a signed MSA or clear purchase intent.
- Alternatively, convert your project to a time-limited "evaluation seat" with reduced quotas that stays active until the PO clears. That requires a quick approval from our finance team.

If you can confirm procurement's estimated clearance date and who we should coordinate with on the PO (procurement@clearpath.ai?), I can escalate and propose a voucher amount that aligns with your integration pacing. I can also attach sample terms for the voucher so your legal team has something to work from.

Which option would you prefer?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0183

Attachment: voucher_terms_preview.txt (txt)

From: Natalie Ruiz <natalie@clearpath.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearpath.ai
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial environment access — PO pending

Jordan — thanks, that sounds promising. Procurement expects the PO to clear by 2026-08-27 but there is a small chance it slips to 2026-09-01 due to a legal review. Our procurement contact is procurement@clearpath.ai (Maya Singh).

I think the voucher option is simplest for us. Can Redwood issue a limited-use voucher that covers roughly 50k tokens / 7 days of active integration? We'll need the voucher terms for our legal team to sign off quickly. If you can send the DocuSign link or a one-page MOU we can triage it internally.

Appreciate the quick support.

—Natalie

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Ruiz <natalie@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, procurement@clearpath.ai
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial environment access — PO pending

Thanks, Natalie — confirmed. We'll issue a conditional sandbox voucher that meets your ask: 50,000 token credit, valid 10 business days from activation, single-use, and automatically deactivates if a PO is not received by 2026-09-03.

Next steps (quick):
1) I'll initiate an internal approvals ticket with Finance for the voucher.
2) Marissa, can you OK the voucher terms and sign the one-page MOU? I've attached the draft.
3) Natalie/procurement: if you can reply with Maya Singh's full name and preferred billing email, we'll include them on the DocuSign.

I've attached the draft MOU and the voucher terms for legal. Once Finance approves I will send a DocuSign link for the MOU and the voucher will be provisioned upon completion.

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: ClearPath_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf), temporary_voucher_terms.txt (txt)
